# publictransport-mcp — llms-full.txt

## What it is

Dual-interface Vienna transit app. Web dashboard (Vite, port 10896) + FastAPI backend (port 11170,
`web_sota/backend/server.py`, fleet-start UvicornTarget `server:app`) + Docker stack (map on 3079,
Grafana on 3140, no database container) + MCP server (`src/publictransport_mcp/server.py`, stdio for Claude Desktop).

## MCP tools (12, FastMCP, stdio)

Essential: `help`, `server_status`.
Multi-city: `list_cities`, `switch_to_city`, `city_transit_stats`.
Search: `station_search` (fuzzy), `nearby_stops` (+ `nearby_stops_by_coordinates`).
Realtime: `next_departures`, `traffic_alerts`, `line_status` (+ status variants).
Schedule/planning: `stop_timetable` (+ line timetable), `journey_planner` (A* multi-transfer),
`routes` info.

Prompts (5): see `src/publictransport_mcp/prompts.py`. Resources (5): `publictransport://network/overview`,
`.../stations/major`, `.../lines/metro`, `.../operating-hours`, `.../fares`.

Claude Desktop config: command `python`, args `["-m", "frontend.mcp_server.server"]`,
env `PYTHONPATH=D:/Dev/repos/publictransport-mcp`, `APP_DB_PATH=<repo>/data/app.db`,
`GTFS_SNAPSHOT_PATH=<gtfs-mcp>/data/snapshots/vienna.db`.

## REST endpoints

- `GET /health`, `GET /api/health` — liveness (fleet-start HealthPath).
- `GET /api/status` — uptime, version.
- `GET /api/skills` — chat skill list (skill-first UI).
- `GET /api/capabilities` — name/version/endpoints/features.
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — routes + system info (CUA-NSIS surface).
- `GET /api/llm/discover`, `GET /api/llm/providers`, `GET /api/llm/models` — Ollama (:11434) / LM Studio (:1234).
- `GET /api/llm/onboarding` — starter facts + recommended path.
- `POST /api/llm/chat` — backend LLM proxy (keys never leave server).
- `GET /api/logs`, `GET /api/logs/stats`, `GET /api/logs/export`, `DELETE /api/logs` — activity ring buffer.
- `POST /api/shutdown` — orderly exit (200 now, exit after 500 ms; used by fleet launcher before restarts).
- Legacy Docker frontend (`frontend/app.py`): `/api/status`, `/api/health`, `/api/status/summary`,
  `/api/traffic-info`, `/api/disruptions`, `/api/v1/journey`, WebSocket realtime.

## Config vars

`DATABASE_URL` (retired — Postgres removed; a set value only warns),
`APP_DB_PATH` (default `./data/app.db`),
`GTFS_SNAPSHOT_PATH` (default sibling gtfs-mcp snapshot), `APP_ENV`,
`WEB_PORT` (default 11170), `FRONTEND_PORTS` (default 10896,3079,3080),
`OPENWEATHER_API_KEY`, `GTFS_FORCE_REFRESH`, `GTFS_REFRESH_DAYS` (default 365), `GTFS_ZIP_PATH`,
`GTFS_METADATA_DIR`, `GRAFANA_PASSWORD`, `WIENER_LINIEN_TEST_MODE`. Template: `.env.example`.

## Ports (registry: mcp-central-docs/operations/WEBAPP_PORTS.md)

Backend 11170, webapp dashboard 10896, Docker map 3079 (container 3080), Loki 3193, Grafana 3140.
State: local SQLite (`data/app.db` WAL + gtfs-mcp snapshot file) — no database container.

## Key files

`src/publictransport_mcp/server.py` (MCP entry), `web_sota/backend/server.py` (web API),
`web_sota/src/` (dashboard), `frontend/app.py` (legacy Docker app), `docker-compose.yml`,
`mcpb/` (Claude Desktop bundle), `justfile` (`just serve|test|lint|fmt|mcpb-pack`).
